summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 7 features for Pigma e-commerce platform. All backend APIs (13/13) and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 features tested and working: 1) Reseller system with products/margin control at /reseller, 2) Admin Orders/Reviews dark theme verified (no bg-white classes), 3) Influencer join flow via ?type=influencer redirects to /influencer, 4) Affiliate product links at /affiliate with Product Links tab, 5) Dynamic RBAC with 20 permission modules at /admin/permissions, 6) Vendor sidebar has overflow-y-auto for scrolling, 7) Credit system logs platform_revenue (mocked mode). Razorpay and Instagram Auto-DM are MOCKED.
